transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: Severus, the Mark's magical signature is... changing. I can't tell whether it's reacting to something external or whether the curse itself is evolving. Your core magic appears stable, but I need to run deeper diagnostic charms that will take several days and may be uncomfortable. I cannot yet tell you whether this is dangerous.

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: Naturally, you would not provide me with that information, would you? The discomfort is of no concern. Continue with your diagnostics. I trust your discretion and assume you have taken the necessary precautions to prevent the— how shall we say it? — 'unauthorized use' of this information.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: Rest assured, Severus, your privacy is of utmost importance to us. The details of your situation remain strictly confidential, safeguarded by the strongest of enchantments. I will proceed with the diagnostics immediately. Should I uncover anything significant, you will be the first to know. May I inquire about any recent changes in your environment or experiences that might provide clues to the signature's evolution?

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: As an employee of the British Ministry of Magic, it would be remiss of me to neglect reporting any... irregularities that might affect my colleagues or the public. There have been no unusual occurrences that I am aware of, apart from the usual uplifting company and delightful ambiance of my workplace. However, I have been feeling an... increased sense of unease, which I attribute to the presence of a certain individual who — undoubtedly due to a lack of magical experience — seems to continually place themselves in harm's way.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: It's quite understandable how certain company can enhance feelings of disquiet, especially in an environment as demanding as the Ministry. Although you mention nothing out of the ordinary, emotional and mental states can indeed influence magical signatures subtly over time. I'll certainly take that into consideration as we proceed. Please keep me informed of any further changes in sensation or occurrences that feel out of place. Your cooperation is invaluable, and any insights, no matter how small, could prove crucial.

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: I will not fail to comply with my civic duties, especially when they involve potentially saving the lives of... less fortunate individuals. If I were to experience anything resembling the onset of a Potions lesson with an untrained-wand-wielding airhead, I would not hesitate to alert you. Until then, continue with your diagnostics. I assume you have informed your superiors of the possibility of extended treatment, as they are known to frown upon unscheduled absences from duty?

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: Certainly, I understand the need for discretion in your professional commitments, Severus. I have noted the possibility of requiring your presence for a little longer than usual and have arranged for the necessary accommodations to ensure your duties are minimally disrupted. We will prioritize the diagnostics so they can be conducted efficiently. Should any significant developments demand further action, I will coordinate with you to manage both your health and your responsibilities seamlessly. Your cooperation and diligence are greatly appreciated.

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: I am not often effusive with gratitude, but your consideration is noted. I trust that your accommodations will not inconvenience my colleagues excessively. Proceed with the diagnostics, and inform me of any findings that might... encourage me to revise my current dietary restrictions. I assume you have also taken steps to prevent... unwelcome interruptions from certain.... nosy individuals? If not, I can provide a list of protective charms that have proven effective in the past.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: Thank you, Severus. Your trust is not taken lightly. We've implemented layers of protective spells around this matter, and only those who are directly involved in your care or authorized by you will have any access. Any propensity for interference has been fully anticipated, and your list of charms would be a welcome addition for ensuring even greater security. As for dietary considerations, any treatment implications will certainly be communicated in full; your well-being remains our primary concern. I shall proceed with the diagnostics and keep you informed with complete transparency.

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: Your reassurances are... comforting, in a manner of speaking. I will provide the list of charms upon my return. As for my well-being, I would remind you that I am not a patient of St. Mungo's but a... subject of research. Any information gleaned from this... 'dietary consideration' should be treated with the utmost confidentiality and care, for it could potentially have wider implications. I trust you understand the gravity of this situation. Now, if you will excuse me, I have... less pressing matters to attend to.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: Of course, Severus. We fully grasp the significance of your circumstances and will handle all findings with the utmost diligence and confidentiality. Your contributions, both as a subject of this research and in your other capacities, are immeasurable, and we respect your requirements completely. I look forward to receiving your list of charms, and I will keep you apprised of any developments the moment they arise. Thank you for your cooperation thus far. Should you need anything else, do not hesitate to reach out. Until then, attend to your matters, and we will continue our work here.

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: I... appreciate your understanding and professionalism. I will provide the list of charms at my earliest convenience. Should you require... 'supplementary' information or wish to discuss any aspect of the diagnostics in greater detail, I am available. Until then, I will endeavor to... not die in your care. A pleasure, as always.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: Thank you, Severus. Your willingness to provide additional insights is invaluable, and rest assured, we shall do everything within our power to ensure your continued health and safety. It is always a pleasure working with someone of your stature and expertise. I will reach out should anything require deeper discussion. Take care until we meet again.

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: I... trust you will. Wishing you a... profitable endeavor.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: Thank you, Severus. May we both find success in our respective endeavors.

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: Indeed. Now, if you will excuse me, I have... priorities to attend to. Good day.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: Good day, Severus.

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: ... (muttering under his breath) ... priorities... (as he strides away, the door closing with a firm click)
